email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 81-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoGlutide (dose: 1 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-05.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
